summary: Frontend testing of the new Analyses tab in /portal/production (Fabricant). Login via OTP flow, tab navigation, all analytics test-ids, chart rendering, Tout/Aucune buttons, chip toggling, PieChart category detail, regression on other tabs and Nouvelle recette modal all validated successfully.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Console warning 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' from Geographies component (react-simple-maps) — unrelated to Production module but should be fixed in whichever page uses <Geographies>.

Non-blocking: 'Exporter tout (PDF)' element with data-testid='production-export-all' returned no href attribute — it appears to be a button rather than an <a> tag. Element is present and clickable; consider making it a real <a href=...> so users can right-click → open in new tab.
test_credentials: fab-analytics@sawali-test.com / Analytics@2026 (OTP retrieved via dev_otp from /api/auth/login response).
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seed (5 recipes, 12 intrants).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Analyses tab is fully functional. Auth flow works via POST /api/auth/login (returns dev_otp inline for sawali-test.com domain) then POST /api/auth/verify-otp with {session_token, code}; token stored in localStorage as 'sawali_token'. Welcome briefing can be bypassed via sessionStorage/localStorage flag 'sawali_welcome_briefing_seen'='1'. Tab order confirmed: Recettes / Intrants (12) / Analyses / Paramètres.
